text:
Alex G: Quick heads-up: I'm spinning up mistral-7b-instruct q4f16 on dev-staging for onboarding experiments. Need a fast sanity pass (hallucination + math + tokenization) before we promote to dedicated. Anyone available?

Sam P: On it. Can you drop the staging endpoint + sample prompts?

Alex G: Sure — endpoint: https://dev-staging.redwood.internal/api/v1/generate
Sample curl:
```
curl -X POST https://dev-staging.redwood.internal/api/v1/generate \\n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_DEV_KEY' \\n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\n  -d '{"model":"mistral-7b-instruct-q4f16","input":"Add 512 + 489","max_tokens":64,"temperature":0}'
```
Commit with this build: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/commit/6a7b9f

eval-bot: Smoke eval finished: 12/36 prompts failed (mostly arithmetic), avg latency 240ms, p95 410ms. Dashboard: https://evals.redwood.internal/runs/2026-03-18/234

Maya R: Do we have quantization knobs? q4f16 vs q8? Might be KV cache hitting. Also check tokenizer mismatch (bpe vs sentencepiece) — saw tokenization drift earlier on this family.

Tess L: I ran the '3-digit add' test. Examples:
```
prompt: "What is 512 + 489?"
model: "1001"
expected: "1001"
prompt: "What is 123 + 456?"
model: "579"
expected: "579"
prompt: "What is 997 + 8?"
model: "1005"   # edge-case here
```
Some are OK, some off-by-one-ish on carries.

Jordan K: Could be decoding/eos handling or tokenizer special token mapping — quant shouldn't introduce carry errors. Try running with explicit eos_token and deterministic sampler (top_p=0, temperature=0) and compare fp32 vs q4f16.
Command:
```
curl ... -d '{"model":"mistral-7b-instruct-q4f16","input":"512+489","temperature":0,"max_tokens":8,"eos_token":"\\n"}'
```
Also please dump kv-cache usage stats in runtime logs.

Alex G: Will do. Kicking off deterministics now and dumping kv stats (log path: /var/log/redwood/devstaging/mistral7b/kvdump-1772000001.log). Also launching A/B run vs ckpt-20270310-fp32.

eval-bot: Added ticket INF-789 to track regression, assigned to @Alex G and @Tess L. Re-running smoke after fixes. :construction:
